'''December 2000 Illinois tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Illinois in December 2000. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1567">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-22-hell-12-22-2000d1567/ hell-12-22-2000], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 22 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-22-hell-12-22-2000d1567/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' December 2000
* '''Site:''' Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 6
